text:
Owen L: Heads up finance 10/04 I paid shipping + customs for the conference swag on my personal card. Total came to €1,680 (shipping €1,200 + customs/duties €480). Vendor only provides freight receipt and customs broker gave a separate receipt with brokerage reference but no VAT id. How should I submit?
Priya S: Did you pay the customs fee to the carrier or to a broker company? That matters for reclaiming VAT/duties.
Owen L: Customs was charged by "EuroShip Brokers" and they emailed a simple PDF receipt with a broker ref number and breakdown: duties €320, VAT €160. The freight company receipt lists the shipment value and freight only. I have both PDFs.
Samir R: Thanks Owen. For VAT reclaim we need the broker's VAT reg number and a tax invoice showing VAT charged. A broker receipt that just lists VAT amount but no VAT reg number isn't sufficient for reclaim. Do you have the broker company registration or contact?
Owen L: I have the broker email header and their remittance reference but no registration id on the PDF. I can forward them an email asking for VAT reg number and a full invoice.
Finance Bot: Policy reminder: cross-border shipping and customs reimbursements require vendor invoices with tax registration for any VAT reclaim. If we can't obtain VAT registration, finance will still reimburse but VAT will be treated as non-reclaimable (classified to duty/other non-reclaimable).
Priya S: Also note: since the total > €1,500, we need PO approval if this was charged outside of an approved PO. Was a PO created?
Owen L: No PO was open. We shipped faster than PO process to meet conference lead time. Marketing approved verbally.
Samir R: Okay. Two actions: 1) Owen, ask EuroShip Brokers for a full tax invoice including VAT reg number (push for PDF). 2) Priya or marketing should raise a retroactive PO in Coupa and attach the two receipts + broker email thread. Finance will hold reimbursement until PO + invoice OR will do interim reimbursement (gross) if manager approves and we mark VAT non-reclaimable.
Owen L: Can we do interim reimbursement? My card statement closes Friday and Id like funds before month-end.
Priya S: I can provide manager approval here. Marketing approves interim reimbursement net/gross as needed.
Samir R: With manager approval we can process an interim reimbursement. AP needs: 1) personal card statement screenshot, 2) freight receipt, 3) broker receipt, 4) manager approval comment, 5) GL allocation. Since this is event swag, split should be MARK-SWAG-2025. If part was co-marketing, include split instructions.
Owen L: Entire shipment is marketing. GL: MARK-SWAG-2025. Uploading docs to Concur now and will mark "interim - awaiting VAT invoice".
Finance Bot: Note: if EuroShip later provides VAT reg number and compliant invoice, finance will reclaim VAT and adjust ledger (credit back non-reclaimable VAT). Please retain original payment trace.
AP Team Bot: Owen  we received your Concur submission (ref 88421). Expedited interim reimbursement approved with manager note. Expected payout in 3 business days. Please forward any broker invoice if received so we can process reclaim.
Owen L: Thanks all. I'll chase EuroShip and ping here when I have their tax ID. :pray:
